One crowd, eleven layouts the chart does not ship

820 dots, one per employee. A unit layout is a plain function of every mark and the plot rect, returning positions, so a shape can be registered from outside the library. Switch views: the same dots flow into the next arrangement, keeping their identity, colour and size, rather than the chart being torn down and rebuilt.

Same data, same dots. Only the position provider changes.
